IREF (~10uA) is the ideal high-Z load of the cascoded gain node, so A0 is several hundred and the node cap is a few fF, giving GBW of about 4 GHz. A ~12uA follower drives the 200fF CL and places its pole near 150MHz. Cf sets near-Butterworth damping for BW of about 55MHz. Total current is about 23uA, or 41uW. vout equals Vgs1, about 0.5V."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 8.0, 22.0),      # input device gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),       # input device L (flicker vs Cin)
    "gmid4": (18.0, 10.0, 22.0),     # follower gm/Id
    "I4":    (12e-6, 5e-6, 16e-6),   # follower bias current
    "Rf":    (420e3, 400e3, 600e3),  # feedback resistor (sets Zt, noise)
    "Cf":    (5e-15, 1e-15, 20e-15), # feedback cap (damping)
    "vds1":  (0.3, 0.18, 0.45),      # target VDS of input device (cascode bias)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    Rf, Cf, I4 = p["Rf"], p["Cf"], p["I4"]

    # Input device: carries exactly IREF (IREF is the load of the gain node)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], iref, vds=p["vds1"])
    vout = m1.vgs                                  # DC: vin = vout (no current in Rf)
    # Follower (drain at vdd, source at vout)
    m4 = lut.size("n", p["gmid4"], 0.15, I4, vds=vdd - vout, vsb=vout)
    vx = vout + m4.vgs                             # gain node = ibias node
    # Cascode
    m2 = lut.size("n", 14.0, 0.15, iref, vds=max(vx - p["vds1"], 0.2), vsb=p["vds1"])
    vcas = p["vds1"] + m2.vgs
    # Cascode gate divider (~0.9 uA)
    Rtot = 2.0e6
    R2 = Rtot * vcas / vdd; R1 = Rtot - R2
    Idiv = vdd / Rtot
    # Follower resistive tail
    Rt = vout / I4

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "ibias", "vcas", "d1", "vss", m2)     # IREF flows into ibias = gain node
    n.dev("M4", "vdd", "ibias", "vout", "vss", m4)
    n.R("RT", "vout", "vss", Rt)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "iin", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "vout", "iin", Cf)
    n.R("RB1", "vdd", "vcas", R1)
    n.R("RB2", "vcas", "vss", R2)
    n.C("CB", "vcas", "vss", 100e-15)

    # ---- small-signal prediction ----
    gm1 = m1.gm; gm4 = m4.gm; gmb4 = m4.gmbs
    gx = m1.gds * m2.gds / max(m2.gm, 1e-9)
    Cx = m2.cdd + m4.cgd + 0.15 * max(m4.cgg - m4.cgd, 0) + 2e-15
    Cin = cpd + m1.cgg
    gL = 1.0 / Rt + m4.gds
    CL2 = cl + 1e-15
    f = np.logspace(3, 10, 2000); s = 2j * PI * f
    Yf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cf
    K = (Yf - gm4 * gm1 / (gx + s * Cx)) / (gm4 + gmb4 + gL + s * CL2 + Yf)
    Z = K / (s * Cin + Yf * (1 - K))
    Zm = np.abs(Z); Z0 = Zm[0]
    below = np.where(Zm < Z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3db = float(f[below[0]]) if len(below) else 1e10
    zt = db(Z0)

    w = 2 * PI * 1e6
    en2 = 4 * kT * 1.0 / gm1
    in2 = 4 * kT / Rf + en2 * (w * (Cin + Cf)) ** 2
    power = vdd * (iref + I4 + Idiv)

    return n, {"zt_dbohm": zt, "f3db": f3db, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout, "in_noise_1m": math.sqrt(in2)}
